The ideal candidate for this position must hold a current 5G Pipe Welder Certification. Possession of a class 6G Certification is highly desirable. Tour of duty for this position is: Monday-Friday 6:30AM -3:00PM. The individual selected for this position will: This is an Essential-Employee Position.

The employee will be required to report to work during emergencies AND inclement weather situations. Work schedule will include mandatory overtime on holidays AND weekends on a regular and recurring basis. Required to obtain a Backflow Preventer certification and required to keep records of all Backflow Preventers serviced/installed.

Perform all required testing that is then reported to the DC Water and Sewer Authority (WASA).

Pipefitting Projects, Maintenance and Repair: Serves as expert pipefitter and plumber and utilize the (Building Automation System) to troubleshoot, start/stop systems, pumps, motors, verify operating parameters and make adjustments to meet building requirements. Also utilize the BAS system to identify electronic faults in pumps and valves.

Utilizes the electronic Building Automation System (BAS) and related technology to install, monitor, diagnose, repair and maintain multifaceted, diverse vendor products as required to sustain the operations of the U.S. Congress.

Adjusts electronically controlled Variable Frequency Drives and related Direct Digital Controls utilized on plumbing systems. Install, troubleshoot and replace faulty electronic Direct Digital Control Energy valves. Utilizes Web TMA to create work orders, document labor hours and annotate the nature of the tasks or problems.

Utilize Mobile TMA (I Phone) to scan equipment and identify defective parts to expedite procurement of replacement parts. Utilizes BAS to access fountain equipment, identify fault locations and expedite repairs. Performs maintenance repairs on all systems: steam, chilled water, domestic water and heating.

Perform maintenance, repair, installation and inspection of steel, copper and Chlorinated Polyvinyl Chloride (CPVC) life safety sprinkler systems in multi-story, historic buildings. Layout and install steel, copper and CPVC life safety sprinkler systems in high ceilings.

Must ensure design and code compliance during installation and inspection of steel, copper and/or CPVC sprinkler systems in new and/or retrofitted construction.

Installs, modifies and repairs new and existing high and low pressure steam lines, gas, air vacuum and water distribution systems, sanitary and storm sewers, sprinkler and chilled water systems, and other piping systems such as ventilation hoods, pumps and standard plumbing equipment, such as toilets, sinks, urinals, water heaters, fountains, drinking water systems, eye washes, safety showers, backflow preventers.

Performs, brazing, soldering and other hot work processes, such as welding.

Environmental Waste Management: Duties assigned, employees may require knowledge of hazardous (e.g. lead paint and solvents), universal (e.g. lamps and batteries and/or non-hazardous (e.g. oil and polychlorinated biphenyl) waste management requirements to ensure compliance with environmental regulations.

Decides what hazardous material is no longer needed and will be disposed, select containers for waste accumulation, add waste to containers, label containers. Performs other related duties as assigned.
You must meet all eligibility and qualification requirements by the closing date of the job announcement. You must meet the following SCREEN-OUT(S) required for this position. Skilled in performing journey level pipefitting and plumbing work without more than normal supervision. Possession of current 5G Pipe Welder Certificate.

Major duties include but are not limited to: Medical Gas Systems Maintains and repairs piped medical gas systems including oxygen, nitrous oxide, and vacuum systems. Responds to alarms, traces pressure drops, tests outlets with flow meters, and isolates faulty zones.

Adjusts regulator pressures, calibrates alarm thresholds, and verifies flow rates at outlets. Coordinates with third-party vendors for annual certification and responds to deficiencies. Liquid Systems Maintains and repairs domestic and process water systems, including potable water, RO/DI systems, and sanitary waste systems.

Follows emergency water supply procedures. Installs, repairs, and maintains plumbing fixtures including water closets, tubs, showers, and sinks. Addresses plumbing issues such as sewer main backups, water leaks, and fixture failures. Lubricates pump bearings, flushes mixing valves, and monitors pump operation.

Inspects pressure gauges, valves, and piping for leaks, corrosion, or damage using flashlights, mirrors, and thermometers. Replaces leaking pipe sections, failed pumps, and PRVs using appropriate joining methods, pipe wrenches, soldering tools, and thread sealant.

Tests repaired lines for pressure integrity, verifies pump operation, and performs backflow preventer testing. Cleans sewer mains semi-annually using high-pressure jetters or mechanical augers. Therapy pool Maintains and repairs therapy pool systems to ensure safe water quality and mechanical reliability.

Cleans filters, lubricates pump bearings, and inspects chemical feed lines. Performs daily water chemistry testing for bromine, pH, and alkalinity; inspects motors, valves, and adjustable pool floor. Verifies pump and lift operation and maintains inspection logs for compliance with health and safety standards.

Irrigation Systems Installs, maintains and repairs below ground watering systems to include sprinklers and drip lines to ensure efficient water distribution for lawns and landscapes. Performs system startups, seasonable adjustments, troubleshooting malfunctions and programs controllers.

Fire Suppression Systems Maintains and repairs fire suppression systems in accordance with NFPA 25 and VA safety standards. Replaces sprinkler heads, valves, flow switches, and pipe sections using pipe wrenches and sealant. Adjusts pump pressure switches and calibrates alarm thresholds.

Performs weekly/monthly fire pump tests, annual hydrant flushing, and alarm/flow switch verification. Documents all testing and maintenance activities; coordinates with contractors for annual NFPA inspections and 5-year internal pipe inspections. General Maintenance Coordinates with contractors for large-scale projects.

Ensures compliance with building codes and safety standards. Performs other duties as assigned.

This is an approach to healthcare that empowers and equips people to take charge of their health and well-being and live their lives to the fullest. As an employee operating in a Whole Health System of care, you will operate in a model with three core elements, seeking to create a personalized health plan for each Veteran.

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. Physical Requirements: Lifts and carries materials and equipment weighing up to 50 pounds, occasionally weighing up to 100 pounds. Bends, kneels, crouches, and stands for extended periods. Uses hand and power tools requiring coordination and manual dexterity. Works in confined spaces and performs tasks that involve considerable physical effort.

You will be asked to participate in a pre-employment examination or evaluation as part of the pre-employment process for this position. Questions about physical demands or environmental factors may be addressed at the time of evaluation or examination.

Working Conditions: Works in mechanical rooms, patient care areas, and outdoors, exposed to varying temperatures and weather conditions. Subject to noise, fumes, and vibrations from tools and equipment.

Works in potentially hazardous environments, requiring adherence to safety protocols and the use of personal protective equipment (PPE) such as gloves, safety glasses, and hearing protection. Occasionally encounters biological and chemical hazards and follows stringent hygiene and safety practices.

Duties May Include But are Not Limited to the Following: The incumbent is considered a working leader in charge of all work performed by the Pipefitter Shop.

As such, incumbent leads seven (8): WG-4204-10, Pipefitters and one (1): WG-4749-10, Maintenance Mechanic, and any other temporary mechanics or summer working aids assigned on an occasional basis.

Incumbent may be called upon to advise Engineering Technicians, Engineers, Shop Supervisors, M&O Foreman, Assistant/Chief Engineer, and others on matters related to his/her field. Serves as a lead subject matter expert for pipe-fitting and plumbing discussion, design, and/or standard of operation and policies.

Tracks the Legionella Preventive Maintenance Program for plumbing to ensure compliance of local, VA and VISN Directives for Legionella Prevention Program. Answers questions regarding sections work both from within service and from outside service personnel.

In addition, incumbent will lead any purchasing efforts and hire personnel for any hospital non-recurring or minor projects connected with the Pipefitter Shop. Coordinate with other shops and sections when needed for project support. Ensures work is being completed in a proper, satisfactory, and timely manner.

Assigns work to shop employees and sets interval priority lists related to work. Coordinates work orders from MAXIMO including time and labor costs. Incumbent is responsible for maintaining stock levels of all parts and supplies needed for operation, repair and upkeep of all items assigned to the Pipefitter Shop.

Incumbent spot checks work of all shop personnel to ensure quality, accuracy and compliance with trade codes and facility standards. Demonstrates proper work methods to shop staff. Ensures section has appropriate safety gear, tools, parts, training, and paperwork to accomplish mission.

Acts within scope of authority to negate negative issues as they arise. Incumbent prepares irregular tours and other schedules and submits them in advance to the Shop Supervisor for approval. Passing along work and guidance from shop supervisor to other workers. Providing shop supervisor and management updates on shop performance and concerns.

Timekeeping for shop staff, as determined by supervisor, Incumbent recommends approval or disapproval of annual, LWOP, and sick leave for shop personnel, recommends promotions, disciplinary action, reassignments, and will furnish to the immediate supervisor written monthly recommendations for performance ratings for each assigned employee.

Incumbent shall assist in writing accident reports, incentive awards, suggestions and/or work simplification. Incumbent is responsible for providing updated data on all items under the preventive maintenance program, recording on work orders all repaired data including time, parts, materials and cost of items used.

Generates and signs subsidiary time and attendance sheets and checks accuracy and signs employee activity sheets. Ensure MAXIMO reflects accurate work for section, builds work orders for work done without existing work order as needed, and follow up on long-life work orders that have not been completed.

Review work with staff to ensure accurate and correct completion.

The incumbent will perform the duties of Journeyman Pipefitter, and/or lead subordinates to accomplish the following: Incumbent is required to accomplish all tasks by following appropriate technical data, blueprints, free hard sketches, work orders, verbal instructions and by using correct test equipment, tools and protective clothing.

Many tasks are pain­staking, requiring complete concentration and attention to details at all times. The purpose of this work is to provide uninterrupted control of the environment in designated areas. Maintains orderly and accurate records of his work, time and repair cost, as prescribed in all applicable maintenance programs.

The incumbent will be required to ensure timely performance of daily, monthly, etc. preventative maintenance checks of various pieces of building service equipment and record data, make repairs and/or adjustments, or call in a work order as instructed. Operates a motor vehicle for transportation to and from various work sights.

Bist das Du?
Wo Echthandwerk auf moderne Infrastruktur trifft: Halte die Adern unseres Life\-Science\-Standorts am Laufen!
Du bist gelernter Sanitärinstallateur, beherrschst das klassische Handwerk im Schlaf und suchst eine vielseitige Herausforderung in einem spannenden Umfeld? Bei uns verbindest du dein solides Praxiswissen aus dem Sanitärbereich mit moderner Gebäudetechnik.

Ob gewohnte Wartungs\- und Reparaturarbeiten, Nasszellen, Rohrleitungen und Entwässerungen oder der Blick auf spezielle Anlagen wie Pumpen, Wasseraufbereitung und Sprinkler: Du packst selbstständig an und behältst auch im dynamischen Alltag den Überblick.

Du musst kein Raketentechniker sein – bei uns zählen echtes Können, Pragmatismus und die Bereitschaft, Neues dazuzulernen. Als geschätzte Fachkraft arbeitest du eng mit internen Kolleg:innen und externen Partnern zusammen und sorgst so direkt dafür, dass an unserem High\-Tech\-Standort alles reibungslos läuft.

Lust auf Abwechslung, Verantwortung und ein starkes Team? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig!
Das erwartet Dich
Du sorgst für den zuverlässigen Betrieb, Unterhalt und die Instandhaltung von Sanitäranlagen.

Description de l’entreprise
Ici, le travail parle avant tout le reste. Les chantiers valaisans ont leurs exigences, leurs rythmes, leurs équipes qui se connaissent et une culture du travail bien fait qui ne se raconte pas, elle se vit.
Nous sommes une agence de placement active dans toute la Suisse (28 agences), mais c'est ici, en Valais, que nous cherchons quelqu'un d'ancré. Quelqu'un qui connaît les entreprises locales, leurs façons de travailler, et qui n'a pas besoin d'apprivoiser la région avant d'être efficace.
Pour l'un de nos partenaires établis en Valais, nous sommes à la recherche d'un·e installateur·trice sanitaire.
Description du poste
Du neuf comme de la rénovation, de la planification jusqu'à la mise en service vous couvrez l'ensemble du cycle d'une installation sanitaire.
Planification & organisation
· Étudier les plans d'architecte ou de bureau technique, définir les besoins et calculer les dimensions
· Évaluer les quantités de matériaux, fixer les délais et établir les plans de montage
· Organiser l'approvisionnement, le transport et l'entreposage du matériel sur chantier
Pose de conduites
· Préfabriquer et poser les réseaux d'alimentation eau et gaz, ainsi que les conduits d'évacuation des eaux usées
· Couper, raccorder, souder et fixer les canalisations dans murs, sols et plafonds
· Raccorder l'installation au réseau public, procéder aux essais d'étanchéité et consigner les résultats
· Isoler les conduites contre le bruit, la condensation et l'incendie
· Mettre en service, contrôler et régler la pression
Montage & installation
· Installer lavabos, douches, baignoires, WC, chauffe-eau, adoucisseurs et robinetteries
· Poser des installations solaires thermiques ou photovoltaïques et des systèmes de ventilation
· Assurer le contrôle final et rédiger les rapports de chantier
Entretien & dépannage
· Localiser et réparer les fuites, déboucher, détartrer, remplacer joints, filtres et appareils défectueux
· Intervenir rapidement chez les clients dans le cadre de contrats d'entretien
· Assurer la maintenance des outils et des machines, trier et éliminer les déchets selon les normes en vigueur
Profil recherché
· CFC d'installateur/trice sanitaire
· Expérience solide sur des chantiers en Suisse, idéalement en Valais
· À l'aise aussi bien sur du neuf que sur de la rénovation et du dépannage
· Capable de lire des plans techniques et de travailler en autonomie
· Disponible et réactif — le secteur ne prévient pas toujours avant de tomber en panne
· Bon esprit d'équipe : vous coordonnez régulièrement avec maçons, chauffagistes, carreleurs et électriciens
Nous offrons
Les entreprises avec lesquelles nous travaillons en Valais ont bonne réputation, et ce n'est pas un hasard. Vous intégrez un environnement où le métier est respecté et où votre expérience a de la valeur dès le premier jour.
· Poste fixe avec un salaire à la hauteur de votre expertise
· Perspectives réelles d'évolution et de formation continue
· Un réseau d'entreprises partenaires solides dans la région
· Et bien sûr, vous travaillez là où vous vivez
